Product received in mail was as described. package was good with protection in bubble wrap from possible damages. Great value (cheaper than most other sites). OEM part so exact fit for my dryer model. Quality part with good reputation from the Blue Stars Company. These guys helped me make sure the part I ordered would fit my model and were very responsive when I had questions. Part was easy & fast to install (didn’t have instructions but I found websites with video instructions/tutorials to help the install process.) If you are a “handy person” who can take out a few screws, then you can replace this part. Total start to finish install time was less than 30 minutes. Replacing the part myself saved me hundreds of dollars in service charges from a professional or needing to buy a new dryer. After install, this fixed my “E1” error code on my Whirlpool Duet front load electric dryer model #GEW9200LW0. Also putting this part in possibly saved my home from burning down because when I took the front panels off the amount of lint buildup I discovered was at a highly dangerous level so I cleaned all the vents with a household vacuum. I now have a safer appliance that runs as good as new!

We needed something to get us by as our dryer broke and new one would not be delivered for a couple weeks. I was sceptical after reading reviews of a bunch of these smaller dryers. Went with this one, even though a little more expensive, just because of how quickly I could get it delivered. I received it in perfect condition. No dents. Hooked it up in 3 minutes (just put it on top of my broken full size Samsung piece of junk broken dryer until they come to replace it) hooked up the dryer vent and it was ready to go. I only did a half load of clothes to start thinking it was not going to be able to handle, but it is a really good size. Able to handle a medium sizedoad if laundry with ease. Dries quicker than I expected. Make sure you clean the lint filter after every load and you will get great results. Highly recommend this dryer whatever the reason you may need it for.
